title: Control flags X18e: delete the 6 dead flag names and move the 8 environment test seams behind injected fields
summary: Dead: EVOLVE_WORKTREE_PATH and EVOLVE_REFLECTION_JOURNAL (registry rows, no reader), EVOLVE_RESUME and EVOLVE_RESUME_MODE (written, never read: go/cmd/evolve/cmd_loop_args.go:357, go/internal/core/resume_bootstrap.go:128), EVOLVE_SANDBOX_FALLBACK_ON_EPERM (a JSON tag only), EVOLVE_RELEASE_STRICT_PASS (messages only). Test seams: EVOLVE_PROFILES_DIR_OVERRIDE, ADAPTERS_DIR_OVERRIDE, LEDGER_OVERRIDE (go/internal/paths/paths.go:52-62), EVOLVE_PROMPTS_DIR, BRIDGE_TESTING, BRIDGE_<X>_BINARY, CG_TEST_INSTALL, CG_TEST_FORCE_MISSING. Lists: docs/architecture/control-flags.md classes (d) and (e).
fix: Delete each dead name, its registry row and its writer. Move each test seam into an injected field of the package Deps or Options struct that tests set. Regenerate control-flags.md with evolve flags generate.
acceptance: RED first: the flag registry lists EVOLVE_WORKTREE_PATH with no production reader; a registry test that requires a reader for each row fails today
No class (d) or (e) name has a production environment read after the change
The tests that used a seam set the injected field instead and still pass
Changed functions at 100% coverage; control-flags.md regenerated and its class tables updated
